text: The media analysis had been calling Gemini through a moving alias, gemini-flash-latest, and on 11 September 2026 that alias returned a high-demand error on four separate live attempts. The default is now one pinned model version, which can be changed through a single setting. Each analysis call now records the model it asked for, the model that actually answered, and whether a backup was used. That record is written for each call, not copied from a settings file.
